name: sentryflow
description: Permission-aware agent execution platform exposed as an MCP server, with a simulated Alexa+ household client.
author: ethical0101

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
